settings.heading: HOW TO APPLY
settings.subtitle: PRESS-ON NAILS // INSTALL YOUR SET
settings.introduction: A little preparation goes a long way. Follow these steps for applying your NailScene press-on nails with glue or adhesive tabs.
settings.image_alt: NailScene application infographic illustrating nail preparation, glue or adhesive tab placement, pressing the nail into place, and finishing with cuticle oil.
settings.note_heading: PRO TIP // GET THE BEST FIT
settings.note_body: Start with clean, dry nails. Follow the instructions on your chosen adhesive and avoid getting nail glue on your skin. Let your press-ons set before getting them wet.

settings.title: PREP & CLEANSE
settings.description: Gently push back your cuticles using the cuticle stick.

settings.title: FILE & BUFF
settings.description: Lightly file and buff the surface of your natural nails using the nail file and buffer block.

settings.title: CLEAN WITH ALCOHOL
settings.description: Wipe your natural nails with an alcohol pad and allow them to dry.

settings.title: APPLY THE ADHESIVE
settings.description: Apply nail glue to the middle of your natural nail and press-on nail. If using an adhesive tab, apply it to your natural nail.

settings.title: PRESS INTO PLACE
settings.description: Position the press-on at roughly a 45-degree angle, then press and hold for 10–15 seconds. With adhesive tabs, press the nail gently toward your cuticle.

settings.title: FINISH YOUR SCENE
settings.description: Apply cuticle oil as a finishing touch. Your NailScene set is ready!
